payload.summary: prettierignore lists one generated data snapshot but not its sibling
payload.detail: data/outstanding-issues-snapshot.json is in .prettierignore; data/repo-awareness-snapshot.json, added by Phase 2, is not. The repo-awareness file passes prettier --check today, so nothing is broken and this is latent rather than live. The asymmetry makes the one listed entry read as arbitrary. Resolve it in whichever direction is right - the answer may well be removing the older entry rather than adding the newer one.
